notes.hook: kids chanting a vegetable rhyme in class, then a delivery boy walks in asking for a 5-star rating
notes.what_goes_wrong: The rating joke peaks at 26s and the last 20s repeat the chant; ending right after the payoff would raise completion.
notes.reusable_pattern: Collide two everyday worlds everyone knows (classroom plus delivery-app rating culture) in one absurd scene.
